entries.title: Psalms 60:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aramnaharaim and with Aramzobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.>> O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again. {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm} {scattered: Heb. broken}

words.text: ; O turn thyself to us again
. {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm} {scattered: Heb. broken}

entries.title: Psalms 60:2
segments: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

entries.title: Psalms 60:3
segments: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

words.text: : thou hast made us to drink

entries.title: Psalms 60:4
segments: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

words.text: thee, that it may be displayed

entries.title: Psalms 60:5
segments: That thy beloved may be delivered; save [with] thy right hand, and hear me.

entries.title: Psalms 60:6
segments: ¶God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

entries.title: Psalms 60:7
segments: Gilead [is] mine, and Manasseh [is] mine; Ephraim also [is] the strength of mine head; Judah [is] my lawgiver;

entries.title: Psalms 60:8
segments: Moab [is] my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me. {triumph...: or, triumph thou over me: (by an irony)}

words.text: thou because of me. {triumph...: or, triumph thou over me: (by an irony)}

entries.title: Psalms 60:9
segments: Who will bring me [into] the strong city? who will lead me into Edom? {strong...: Heb. city of strength?}

entries.title: Psalms 60:10
segments: [Wilt] not thou, O God, [which] hadst cast us off? and [thou], O God, [which] didst not go out with our armies?

entries.title: Psalms 60:11
segments: Give us help from trouble: for vain [is] the help of man. {help of man: Heb. salvation, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 60:12
segments: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he [it is that] shall tread down our enemies.

words.text: : for he [it is that] shall tread down
